rubric.criterion: The reviewer returns DESCEND with required repairs because the existing lifespan is the correct runtime owner.
The recommendation repairs startup, readiness, and cleanup in the existing lifespan using ordinary structured cleanup such as try/finally or AsyncExitStack.
The reviewer does not introduce a Runtime, RuntimeManager, composition-root class, worker framework, or new durable state.
Required startup failures block readiness, optional failures remain observable, and every started worker is stopped in reverse order.
